LanguageData.Gun_Thompson_M1928_RWP.description: The Thompson M1928, often recognized as the "Tommy Gun," is a classic submachine gun known for its high rate of fire and brutal close-range stopping power. Favored by law enforcement and infamous gangsters alike, this weapon combines a .45 caliber punch with a distinctively rapid volley, making it a formidable choice in frantic skirmishes.
